map.《劳动合同法》第82条：用人单位自用工之日起超过一个月不满一年未与劳动者订立书面: Labor Contract Law Article 82: if an employer fails to conclude a written labor contract with a worker within more than one month but less than one year from the start of employment, it shall pay the worker double wages monthly.
map.用工超过一个月未签书面劳动合同，计算用人单位应支付的双倍工资差额。: Employment over one month without a written labor contract: compute the double-wage difference the employer should pay.
map.双倍工资最长支持 11 个月（自用工满 1 个月起至满 1 年止）。: Double wage is supported for at most 11 months (from one month after employment start to the first anniversary).
map.满 1 年未签的视为已订立无固定期限合同，不再继续计算双倍工资。: After a full year without signing, it is deemed a non-fixed-term contract has been concluded, and double wage is no longer calculated.
map.入职 11 个月未签合同: Employed 11 months without a signed contract
map.：2024-03-01 入职、2025-02-28 离职且始终未签合同，双倍工资: : employed 2024-03-01, left 2025-02-28 with no contract ever signed; double-wage period is 2024-04 to 2025-02, 11 months total; monthly wage 8000 CNY, difference = 8000 * 11 = 88,000 CNY.
map.：若 2025-03-01 仍在职，自该日起视为订立无固定期限合同，双倍工资计算: : if still employed on 2025-03-01, from that day it is deemed a non-fixed-term contract has been concluded, double-wage calculation stops, no more months added.
map.双倍工资是再发一倍还是两倍的工资？: Is double wage one extra pay or twice the wage?
map.是「差额」一倍，即已发工资外再补发一倍（共相当于两倍），计算基数为劳动者当月应得: It is one extra 'difference', i.e., an additional pay equal to the already-paid wage (total equivalent to twice), with the calculation base being the worker's due wage of that month.
map.HR 自己忘签能主张吗？: Can HR claim on behalf of an employee who forgot to sign?
map.司法实践对具有人事管理职权的高级管理人员是否支持双倍工资存在争议，普通员工一般可: Judicial practice is disputed on whether senior managers with HR authority can claim double wage; ordinary employees generally can; specifics depend on evidence and local adjudication standards.
